# Steel Bolts (McColt Tool Vendor)

Steel Bolts is the suspicious, cake-loving McColt gate guard from *My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic*. He's the pony who is astonished to discover Equestria has a fourth alicorn princess and later lets a supposed peace-offering cake into the fortress.

[![Steel Bolts at the fortress — Hasbro Studios, Friendship is Magic S5E23; still reproduced by Macintosh & Maud](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/59742c403a041155fa409ef0/1565837829236-BBFGLYA5B0QD57SWQYCC/523%2BSTEEL%2BMCBOLTS.png)](https://www.macintoshandmaud.com/randopony-of-the-week-season-five/2019/8/8/randopony-s5e23-hooffields-and-mccolts)

- **Appearance:** Earth pony stallion with a slate-purple coat, spiky pale turquoise mane, dark blue eyes, thick dark eyebrows, cheek freckles and gray armor. His cutie mark depicts three metal bolts; he shares his palette with Locknut McColt, a different character.
- **Naming:** Steel Bolts is a fandom name, apparently inspired by his cutie mark; its original coiner is unverified. The [stallion catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) identifies him as McColt Tool Vendor in Gameloft's licensed mobile game, where he sells construction hardware. That is a game designation, not a spoken TV name.
- **Speaking status:** Speaking character, voiced by Ian Hanlin, listed as McColt Guard 1 in the [episode cast](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/season/5/episode/23/credits).
- **Appearances:** Confirmed in the television episode *The Hooffields and McColts* (S5E23, November 14, 2015), and in the licensed mobile game's [Hooffields and McColts event](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/The_Hooffields_and_McColts). No other episode, film or comic appearance was verified.

## Important moments

All three scenes are from *The Hooffields and McColts* (S5E23). See the [episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-hooffields-and-mccolts/umc.cmc.8ven9s222p8yyfd2oi13pkj1?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) and [scene transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Hooffields_and_McColts). Exact video timestamps unavailable.

- **A fourth princess?** — He challenges Twilight and Fluttershy at the gate, then suspects Twilight might be a royal spy, illustrating how isolated and distrustful the feuding families have become.
- **The apology cake** — His eagerness for cake prompts him to open the gates, unwittingly admitting Hooffield ponies concealed inside the deceptive gift.
- **Anything but pumpkins** — After the truce, he objects to growing pumpkins, a humorous callback to the vegetables previously used against his family, as the two clans begin cooperating.

Research limitations: the precise origin of the fandom name and video timestamps remain unverified. Fandom pages were accessible through indexed excerpts but returned an access error on direct retrieval. The linked show still was verified; no individual fan artwork was sufficiently useful and verified to include.
